・Vegan Option Available

Brewpub with modern design that serves a good range of vegetarian and vegan comfort food that goes well with their selection of craft beers. Cooking oil not separated. Beers are vegan too!

properties.name: 典座 Tenzo
properties.description:
Vegan Option Available
Creative dishes inspired by Buddhist shojin cuisine. Set lunch available on Mondays and Tuesdays. Other days and dinner also available with advance reservation. White sugar used in some dishes.

properties.name: Okonomiyaki Chinchikurin Nagarekawa お好み焼・鉄板焼 ちんちくりん 流川店
properties.description:
Vegan option available
Lively okomiyaki shop with a clearly-labeled vegan okomiyaki option on its English menu. Although all food is cooked on the same grill, an effort is made to reserve one area for vegan okonomiyaki.

properties.name: Okonomiyaki Chinchikurin Miyajimaguchi お好み焼・鉄板焼 ちんちくりん 宮島口店
properties.description:
Vegan option available
Spacious okonomiyaki restaurant in the retail building attached to the Miyajima-guchi ferry terminal. All food is cooked on the same grill, an effort is made to reserve one area for vegan okonomiyaki.

properties.name: Big Apple vegan cafe
properties.description:
100% vegan
All-vegan cafe, a short taxi ride from Miyajima-guchi Station, that serves curry with brown rice, gyoza pot-stickers, deep-fried soy karaage, as well as desserts and smoothies.

properties.name: France-ya 佛蘭西屋
properties.description:
Vegan option available
Vegan sake pairing set meals, vegan lunch, and dinner courses are available in the heart of Saijo's sake brewing district. Excellent understanding of vegan needs and great care is taken to avoid cross-contamination.

properties.name: grill＆deli LAVE
properties.description:
Vegan option available
Vibrant farm-to-table dining with vegan-friendly options: 4 vegan salads, 2 deli dishes, and hearty vegan soups, crafted for health and beauty.

properties.name: CRAFT BEERと炭火 はればれ
properties.description:
Vegan option available
A limited number of light vegan meals (vegan meatloaf, vegan taco rice, and organic salad) available to complement craft beers brewed on site near Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park.

properties.name: カフェタネムラ vegancafe &restaurant 優しいランチとスイーツ スローフード 自然食無化調
properties.description: 100% vegan cafe/restaurant located in the brush-making capital town of Kumano, in the hills outside Hiroshima. Over 90% of the vegetables used are home-grown and pesticide-free. The menu includes noodle dishes and vegan desserts.

properties.name:
Dashi & Soba (Dashi To Soba) Suisha  ekie Hiroshima
DASHIとSOBA水車 ekie広島店
properties.description:
Vegan Option Available
Several vegan soba and noodle dishes use plant-based kelp stock with a distinctive shiitake mushroom flavor. Vegan tempura and several vegan sides, including hearty onigiri rice balls are all clearly marked in this soba noodle restaurant in Hiroshima Station's ground floor ekie dining zone.

properties.name: SUZU CAFE hiroshima
properties.description:
Vegan Option Available
The menu at this popular cafe in the same building as the Sheraton Hotel in front of Hiroshima Station's North Exit includes vegan appetizers, sides, pasta dishes, and desserts. Vegan options are labeled "Plant-Based."

properties.name:
Hiroshima Okonomiyaki undo
広島お好み焼き undo（あんど）
properties.description:
Vegan Option Available
Vegan and gluten-free Hiroshima-style okonomiyaki made with thin udon noodles in a shared space with several okonomiyaki shops on central Hiroshima's main shopping arcade.
うどん専門のお好み焼き、グルテンフリーのうどんもやってます！2025年3月から全て自家製麺のグルテンフリーのうどんを使ったお好み焼きになります！

properties.name:
HIROSHIMA RAMEN Momiji Miyajima-guchi
広島ラーメン 椛 -momiji- 宮島口本店
properties.description:
Vegan option available
Creamy vegan ramen with cabbage and sweetcorn toppings and vegan vegetable fried gyoza potstickers are available on the upper floor of Etto at the Miyajima-guchi ferry terminal.

properties.name:
Ippeiya
元祖広島まぜ麺 一平や
properties.description:
Vegan option available
There is no need for vegans to miss out on Hiroshima's little know super spicy soupless noodle scene. Generous portions of egg-free noodles, topped with beansprouts and mushrooms, and choose your own spice level chili paste. Black pepper and curry powder toppings are also available.

properties.name:
Restaurant Tachibana
お食事処 たち花
properties.description:
Vegan / Vegetarian option available
A feature of Miyajima's Omotesando shopping street for over 80 years, alongside local favorites like oyster and ell dishes, Tachibana also has a vegan and vegetarian menu featuring udon, soba, Japanese curry, and tempura dishes, served with vegan miso soup.

properties.name: Miyajima Cuillere 宮島キュイエール
properties.description:
Vegan option / Pescatarian option available

One of the few restaurants on Miyajima that is open after dark. The a la carte menu includes vegan appetizers and salads, two vegan pasta dishes, and vegan curry doria. Good wine selection and craft beers also on sale.

properties.name: Miyajima Mori-no-Yado, restaurant Ōmoto 国民宿舎 みやじま 杜の宿 レストランおおもと
properties.description:
Vegan option available

Ryokan next to Omoto Shrine on Miyajima offers an excellent set lunch featuring a selection of inventive Japanese dishes inspired by shojin Buddhist cuisine.

properties.name: Akushu Restaurant / 握手レストラン
properties.description:
Vegan option available.
French and European cuisine on Miyajima’s Omotesando shopping street. Vegan options included soup, salad, pasta, curry, and chickpea hamburger steak. Dessert may contain honey.

properties.name: Teppei Okonomimura てっ平 お好み村3F
properties.description:
Vegan / Vegetarian option available
Egg-free noodles, vegan sauce, separate pancake batter, and lard-free griddle. Mention you are vegan when ordering “Vegetarian” okonomiyaki without egg. Kimchi is also animal-free.
Gluten-free sauce available.
